rules: Fixture approvals are proof-only and can never authorize live operator handoff.
Live approval is bound to the exact render SHA-256, template, platform, and source event.
Every live WNBA team position must use an approved exact logo; text fallbacks are review-only.
Player layouts require a real non-fixture player asset.
No placeholder layers, zone overflow, or mask-compliance failure may enter the live lane.
Live post-ready permits a limited operator handoff only; it does not auto-publish or enable automatic production cutover.
Phase 6H separates technical live candidacy from release-grade handoff; final-score renders below release threshold are visible for review but cannot enter live handoff.
Live-data render filenames must include event identifiers or derived headlines to prevent same-name overwrites.
